BUG-01

Filtering admins by Team crashes the Admins page

High AdminsFunctional Confirmed in the browser

Impact

Admins cannot be filtered by team at all — every Team choice, alone or with a Status, replaces the page with an error screen.

Caught by test cases

  • test_17_filter_by_team — Filtering admins by a team shows that team's admins
  • test_47_filter_team_and_status_combined — Team + Status admin filters work together

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Admins
  2. Click 'Add Filter'
  3. Open the 'Team' dropdown
  4. Choose Team 'pages'
  5. Click 'Apply'
  6. Look at the result of the filter

Expected result

Choosing in 'Add Filter' a Team that listed admins belong to and pressing Apply lists exactly the admins of that team (no error page).

Actual result

filtering by team 'pages' shows the error page: 'Something went wrong loading this page. Retry'

team 'Regression team' + status 'Inactive' shows the error page: 'Something went wrong loading this page. Retry'

Technical details

The list request is sent as GET /admins/admin/list?team[0]=10000003 (team as an array). The backend answers 422 "The team field must be an integer." and the page shows its error boundary "Something went wrong loading this page. Retry". Frontend and API disagree on the shape of the team parameter.

BUG-02

An incomplete event (no Ticketing Setup) can be published through Edit and becomes public

High Fundraising EventFunctional Confirmed in the browser

Impact

Events that were never finished go live on the public website — the rule that blocks publishing from the list is bypassed by the Edit form.

Caught by test case

  • test_59_incomplete_event_cannot_be_published — Fundraising Event: an event without Ticketing Setup cannot be published

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Fundraising Event and click 'Create New Event'.
  2. Fill step 1 (Event Configuration) completely and click 'Save & Next'.
  3. Click 'Save & Next' on step 2 (Event Details) and step 3 (Fundraising Settings) without changes.
  4. On step 4 (Ticketing Setup) add NO ticket — leave the wizard.
  5. In the list, the event is 'Draft'. Click its 'Publish' button and confirm: it is refused ("Event is not publishable…") — correct.
  6. Click the event's 'Edit' button, set Status to 'Published' and click 'Save & Next'.
  7. Open the event list: the event now reads 'Published'.
  8. Open the event's public page in a signed-out browser: it is visible.

Expected result

An event saved up to step 3 (no tickets) stays a Draft: the list's Publish button answers 'Event is not publishable...', and choosing 'Published' in Edit does not publish it either - the list still says Draft and the public page stays unavailable.

Actual result

after choosing 'Published' in Edit and saving, the list says 'Published' although the Ticketing Setup step was never completed; the public page shows the event to signed-out visitors

Technical details

The list's Publish button correctly refuses: "Event is not publishable. Please complete all required fields." In Edit, the Status field is not locked and the note "This event will remain in draft until the 'Ticketing Setup' step is completed" is not enforced: Status = Published + Save & Next stores it as Published, and /fundraising-event/<slug> is visible to signed-out visitors.

BUG-03

User details page corrupts non-Canadian phone numbers (last digit dropped)

High UsersData integrity Confirmed in the browser

Impact

Any admin who opens and saves a user with a non-+1 phone number silently stores a wrong, truncated number.

Caught by test case

  • test_41_details_phone_matches_the_list — The user details page shows the same phone number as the users list

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Users
  2. Find the user nehaleltaweel@mailinator.com — phone in the list: +201147279372
  3. Click 'View details' on that row
  4. Look at the 'Phone Number' field (nothing is saved)

Expected result

Opening 'View details' of a user with an international (non +1) phone shows every digit of the phone the list shows.

Actual result

list shows '+201147279372', the details form shows '+2 (011) 472-7937'

Technical details

List: +201147279372 (Egypt). The details form forces the Canada flag and the North-American mask: "+2 (011) 472-7937" — 11 digits instead of 12, the last digit is lost. The phone input ignores the stored country code.

BUG-05

Posts filter with only 'Date (From)' is ignored — the API rejects it and the UI shows no error

Medium Blog & NewsFunctional Confirmed in the browser

Impact

Filtering posts from a date shows every post, while the filter chip claims the filter is applied — the admin is misled.

Caught by test case

  • test_24_filter_date_from_apply — Filtering posts by 'Date (From)' alone keeps only posts updated on/after that day

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Blog & News
  2. Read the 'Last Updated' column
  3. Click 'Add Filter'
  4. Click 'Select from date' (Date From)
  5. Click 'Previous month' (calendar shows October 2026)
  6. Click day 30 (30 Sep 2026)
  7. Click 'Done'
  8. Click 'Apply'
  9. Look at the filtered list
  10. A post updated on 2026-09-28 is still listed

Expected result

Choosing the newest post's day as Date (From) and pressing Apply lists that post and hides every post last updated before that day.

Actual result

4 post(s) dated before 2026-09-30 are still listed (e.g. 2026-09-28) — Showing 1 to 5 of 5 entries; request ['GET /api/be/api/v1/blog/admin/posts/list?page=1&from_date=2026-09-30T12%3A00%3A00&limit=15&timezone=Africa%2FCairo -> 422']

Technical details

GET /api/be/api/v1/blog/admin/posts/list?page=1&from_date=2026-09-30T12:00:00&limit=15 → 422 "The from date field must be a date before or equal to to date." (the API requires a To date). The UI swallows the 422, shows the chip 'Sep 30, 2026 12:00' and keeps the unfiltered list. To-only and From+To filter correctly.

BUG-08

Clearing the Permissions search and pressing Enter leaves 'No Results Found' (Roles and Teams)

Medium PermissionsFunctional Confirmed in the browser

Impact

After a search with no result, emptying the box and pressing Enter keeps an empty table — the admin thinks there are no roles/teams.

Caught by test cases

  • test_05_roles_clear_search — Emptying the Roles search box and pressing Enter brings the full list back
  • test_33_teams_clear_search — Emptying the Teams search box and pressing Enter brings the full list back

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Permissions (Roles tab; repeat on the Teams tab).
  2. Type a name that does not exist (e.g. 'NoSuchRoleXYZ') in Search and press Enter → 'No Results Found' (correct).
  3. Empty the box quickly (Ctrl+A, Backspace) and press Enter straight away.
  4. Wait: the table stays on 'No Results Found' with an empty search box.

Expected result

After a search with no results, deleting the search text and pressing Enter shows all roles again (the same rows as before the search).

Actual result

pressing Enter right after emptying the box leaves the Roles tab on 'No Results Found' (0 rows instead of 13) with an empty search box; waiting ~1 s before Enter brings the list back (13 rows)

pressing Enter right after emptying the box leaves the Teams tab on 'No Results Found' (0 rows instead of 15) with an empty search box; waiting ~1 s before Enter brings the list back (15 rows)

Technical details

Search runs as you type (debounced). Ctrl+A, Backspace, Enter within ~0.3 s leaves 'No Results Found' with an empty box (0 rows instead of 13 roles / 15 teams). Waiting ~1 s before Enter, or clicking the magnifier, brings the list back — a stale request for the old term finishes after the empty-term request and overwrites it.

Unsaved Profile / Tax Receipting edits are silently lost when switching tabs

Impact

An admin who switches tab before saving loses the changes with no warning.

Caught by test cases

  • test_69_switching_tabs_keeps_profile_edits — An unsaved Profile edit survives switching to Tax Receipting and back
  • test_70_switching_tabs_keeps_tax_edits — An unsaved Tax Receipting edit survives switching to Profile and back

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Profile
  2. Type 'QA Dirty 1790887514' in Brand Name (do not save)
  3. Click the 'Tax Receipting' tab
  4. Click the 'Profile' tab again
  5. Look at Brand Name

Expected result

After typing a new Brand Name (not saved), going to the Tax Receipting tab and back keeps the typed value - or the page warns about unsaved changes before switching.

Actual result

the unsaved edit was silently thrown away: Brand Name is back to 'medanns' and no 'Unsaved Changes' warning came up

the unsaved edit was silently thrown away: Place of Issue is back to '54675647' and no 'Unsaved Changes' warning came up

Technical details

Switching between 'Profile' and 'Tax Receipting' remounts the form and resets it to the stored values. Leaving the page through the sidebar DOES show 'Unsaved Changes', so the app knows the form is dirty — the tab switch should warn too (or keep the values).

BUG-22

AI Builder usage meter does not update after a generation

Low PagesFunctional Confirmed in the browser

Impact

Admins see less AI usage than they really spent until they open a new browser tab.

Caught by test case

  • test_86_ai_generate_from_arabic_prompt_and_bill_usage — An Arabic AI prompt builds Arabic content and the usage meter goes up

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Pages > Info Pages > 'Add New Page' and open the 'AI' side tab.
  2. Read the usage meter above the builder (e.g. $0.71 of $40.00).
  3. Set Interaction to 'Execution', type a prompt and send it — wait for the page to be built.
  4. Read the meter again: it still shows $0.71.
  5. Close the builder and open 'Add New Page' again in the same tab: still $0.71.
  6. Open it in a new tab (or clear the tab's sessionStorage): the meter shows $0.83.

Expected result

In the page builder's AI tab (Execution mode), an Arabic prompt adds blocks with Arabic text to the page, and the '$used of $budget' meter shows the higher usage right after the generation.

Actual result

Arabic blocks were added, but the meter right after the generation still shows $0.71 (also $0.71 after re-opening in the same tab) while the server already has $0.83 - the number is cached in sessionStorage 'builder_ai_state_v4' for the whole tab session

Technical details

The meter is cached in sessionStorage 'builder_ai_state_v4' and only refreshed in the background when the builder mounts. After a generation it still shows $0.71 while the server already has $0.83, also after reopening the builder in the same tab.

How these were confirmed. Each bug was first reported by an automated test, then redone step by step in a visible Chrome window by tools/run_manual_checks.py; every step was screenshotted, with a bar on the page naming the test case and the step. Only behaviour seen in the browser is reported here. Re-check one bug with python tools/run_manual_checks.py -k <test name>.
Severity. High — a feature is broken, data is corrupted or published wrongly. Medium — a feature misbehaves or a rule is not enforced. Low — text, labels, accessibility or cosmetic.
